name: Saiyan armor
notes: Origin at the neck base, face +Z, wearer's left +X. Parts helmet, chest, back, shoulderL, shoulderR, gauntletL, gauntletR (pivots at neck base, sternum, between shoulder blades, shoulder joints, elbows; forearm along -Y). Joints scouter, aura, ki, surge 0...1; followers scouterGlow, auraFlames, kiOrbL, kiOrbR, surgeRings switch option at 0.05. Scouter lens on +X side of the helmet.
parts: open-face white helmet cap with gold brow band and headset with green scouter lens
layered white chest plate with gold edging, collar bar and belly lames over a black undersuit
winged shoulder guards: shoulder cap plus three fanned gold and white feather plates
bracers with gold cuffs, gloves and palm ki orbs
back plate with gold ridge and aura flame crown
power-up halo rings around the torso
style: Anime battle armour, warm white painted alloy plates with chamfered gold trim, winged shoulders, glowing green scouter, blue ki orbs, gold aura.
summary: Saiyan battle armour kit: white and gold plated chest, winged shoulder guards, helmet with glowing green scouter, bracers with palm ki orbs and a gold aura crown.
